unit_note: positions in MapleStory px from v8 data (raw GMS v8 WZ portal nodes; y increases downward). NPC x is the WZ life x; NPC y is the foothold-snapped cy served by /api/GMS/8/map (raw WZ life y is 2-9 px smaller, i.e. higher on screen, for Heena, Roger, Nina, Paul, Tia, Maple Administrator, Pan and Sid; largest: Nina, 9 px). mobs = v8 spawn-point counts, not live population. worldmap_spot_px = pixel position on the 411x348 WorldMap0 illustration (relative direction only, not a scale).
baseline: GMS v8 for topology, positions, geometry, NPCs and spawns; v22 differences are documented as an optional variant (see discrepancies).

kind_legend.town: Outdoor map with the WZ town flag and no monsters (Mushroom Town maps 0-30000, Southperry, Amherst).
kind_legend.field: Outdoor monster map that acts as a road junction or hub: A Split Road (fork), The Field West of Amherst (6-door hub), The Field East of Amherst (end field with a hidden pocket).
kind_legend.hunting: Outdoor monster map that is a training ground: the three Snail Hunting Grounds on the road, plus every dead-end pocket (1000001-1000006, 1010004, 1020001).
kind_legend.interior: Building interior reached by a door portal, with no other exit (20001, 60001, 1010001, 1010003).
kind_legend.townstreet: 'Townstreet template' (cutaway mushroom house on a short street strip) that continues onward: 1010002 Amherst Townstreet. 20001 uses the same template but is a dead end, so it is classed interior.

exit_kind_legend.edge_west: Non-door exit standing on a v8 foothold chain that reaches the map's west (left, in 2D) foothold limit; may sit high up (1000002). Positional: checked by the build script with 0 px tolerance (if the chain reaches both limits, the nearer one decides).
exit_kind_legend.edge_east: Non-door exit standing on a v8 foothold chain that reaches the map's east (right, in 2D) foothold limit; may sit high up (30000, 40002, 50000 east00). Same check as edge_west.
exit_kind_legend.door: Portal at a door object (house, shop, or wooden door in an earth mound) or an interior doorway.
exit_kind_legend.inner: Non-door exit whose foothold chain reaches neither map limit: a mid-air or high ledge (1000000 in01, 1000001 out00, 1020000 in00). kind is positional only; the raw portal type is recorded separately as pt.
exit_kind_legend.other: Not used: NPC-scripted travel (Shanks' ship) is not a portal and is recorded in notes/branches instead.

source_legend.xml: Raw GMS v8 WZ portal node (maplestory.io /api/wz/GMS/8/Data/Map/Map/Map0/<id9>.img/portal/<n>), compiled in docs/research/portals_xml.json.
source_legend.inferred: Reasoned from other evidence; always low confidence.
source_legend.wiki: Archived era fansite/wiki pages (Hidden Street, StrategyWiki, MapleWiki).

maps.name: West Entrance to Mushroom Town

exits.note: East end of the lower lane.

npcs.name: Heena
npcs.role: Tutorial NPC: movement and jump controls (v8 dialogue). Mirror errand to her sister Sera: a quest in the 2005 guide ('Talk to Heena ... This is a quest ... Talk to Sera, she will give you a mirror'); quest IDs and text are [v22 data].

npcs.name: Sera
npcs.role: Heena's sister hanging laundry; ladder/rope climbing hint (v8 dialogue). Gives the mirror for Heena's errand (2005 guide); [v22 data] item name Sera's Mirror.

landmarks: Orange mushroom house with yellow spots on the high west plateau (houseGS/house6 + deco/0), mushroom-awning plank door, iron wall lantern, barrels (standable tops)
Heena perched on a bush / grass clump just above the spawn point
Three 60 px grass steps down from the house plateau to the lower lane
Sera's laundry bluff: raised block climbed by the ladder at x=975, clothesline on Y-shaped posts with shirt, trousers and sheet (the line is a walkable foothold)
Rows of small coloured mushrooms and red-spotted toadstools in the valley
Exit portal out00 at the east end of the lower lane
maps.terrain_style: grassySoil tiles: bright green grass fringe over olive/khaki cobbled dirt with embedded grey stones; solid earth blocks with vertical cliff faces. Backdrop set grassySoil: blue sky, drifting cumulus, distant hill, giant leafy oak, golden meadow strips.
maps.recognizable: The very first screen of the game: new characters appear on the high west plateau beside a big orange mushroom house with yellow spots, while Heena hovers above the spawn point teaching how to move and jump. The lane drops by three grass steps toward a laundry bluff where her sister Sera hangs washing on a line, reached by the only ladder. Pastoral sky, a giant oak behind, no monsters, and the FloralLife town theme. The official 2005 gallery screenshot (docs/research/ref_web/0_1.jpg) shows exactly this scene.
maps.notes: Spawn map: 4 spawn points (sp) at x -206..-112, y~102 on the west plateau; no arrival portal and no portal leads back into map 0. Foothold extent x -264..1254, walkable y 50..365, 9 walkable tiers, 1 ladder. Classic map exists only in GMS v8-v37: from v38 ID 0 is "Entrance - Mushroom Town Training Camp" (never use v38+ data). v22 re-lays out the west half (plateau lower than the lane, steps go up) and moves out00 to (1116,365); v8 is canonical. v22 also adds an Up-key hint sign at the ladder (not in v8). WorldMap0 spot: NW tip of the island. Brief: docs/research/maps/0_WestEntranceMushroomTown_0.md.

Roger stands above the street in a hedge-walled garden; in the words of a 2005 beginner guide he is the 'creepy looking guy' who takes away some of your HP so you learn to open the inventory and eat an apple. Hidden Street (2005) called this map 'Mushroom Town I'.
maps.notes: Arrival point in00 (-195,278) is arrival-only (pt 1, no target). Foothold extent x -309..849 (1158 px), walkable y 65..275, 4 tiers, no ladders. Identical in v8, v22, v40, v55. Brief: docs/research/maps/10000_MushroomTown_10000.md.

East end of the upper town terrace, at the foot of the stone oven/chimney tower.

Everything steps up from the low west lawn to a long raised town terrace, Nina waits on a floating flower islet, a ladder climbs to an empty sky islet, and the road leaves east past a stone oven tower. Hidden Street (2005) called this map 'Mushroom Town II'.
maps.notes: Arrival point in00 (-207,218) is arrival-only. 3 spawn points at x -256..-173. Foothold extent x -309..939 (1248 px), walkable y -85..215, 5 tiers, 1 ladder. v22 extends the upper street east (out00 moves to (1109,97)) and adds an Up-key hint at the door; v8 is canonical. maps.recognizable: Despite the name 'Townstreet', this is Sen's house: a doll-house cutaway of a two-storey mushroom home with a cupboard and the hungry boy Sen downstairs and a bedroom with a bed, chest and curtained window upstairs, joined by a ladder. Players come here for Nina's dinner errand and leave by the same door.

Same 'Townstreet template' as 1010002 Amherst Townstreet: identical door portal out00 (-167,244), ladder x=77, floors y=246/69, roof y=-117. The only spawn point (sp) is outside in the yard at (-329,241). Play space about 360 x 363 px; no minimap. Dead end. Brief: docs/research/maps/20001_MushroomTownTownstreet_20001.md.

maps.name: East Entrance to Mushroom Town

exits.note: Top-east summit, 1140 px (19 tiers of 60 px) above the arrival point; Peter stands beside it.

npcs.name: Peter
npcs.role: Instructor at the exit from Mushroom Town; warns about monsters; brother of Roger and Robin (v8 dialogue). 2005 guide: gives EXP.

landmarks: Yellow mushroom house with a dark brim and a round yellow dormer window (houseGS/house7) on the central hill
Mushroom fountain with a rainbow over a stone basin (acc1/grassySoil/artificiality/9)
Log bench with tiny mushrooms on the middle terrace (standable top)
Tall pale stalk-mushroom clusters at the bottom and on the summit (vertical landmarks)
Ivy-wrapped wooden signposts at the start, at the bottom-right rope and by the summit exit

maps.terrain_style: grassySoil tiles: stepped central hill, large floating earth slabs with sloped grass shoulders, many small oval floating grass islets; 8 slope tiles; grassySoil sky backdrop.
maps.recognizable: The big climb out of Mushroom Town. A 19-tier switchback: east across the valley, up two ropes, back west along a middle terrace, up a ladder, then east over stepping stones to the summit, where Peter guards 'the exit to the Mushroom Town' and warns that monsters roam beyond. The yellow dormer house, the rainbow fountain and the pale stalk-mushrooms mark the way. For new players this was the first real platforming challenge.
maps.notes: Arrival point in00 (-218,217) is arrival-only. Foothold extent x -309..1569 (1878 px), walkable y -925..215 (1140 px = 19 tiers of 60 px), 22 walkable tiers, 2 ladders + 2 ropes. A three-platform staircase next to the arrival is a dead end. No mobs in v8; v22 adds Todd (NPC 2004) and 3 Tutorial Jr. Sentinels (mob 9300018) and reshuffles the climbing aids (not in the v8 baseline). Brief: docs/research/maps/30000_EastEntranceMushroomTown_30000.md.

maps.recognizable: The first hunting field after leaving Mushroom Town, where new players kill their first Snails and Blue Snails. The pastoral town sky gives way to a light autumn woodland with misty mountains and a lake in the backdrop, and the calm 'Rest N Peace' field theme starts. Robin waits at the entrance with combat tips and tells you to head northeast.
maps.notes: Arrival point in00 (-172,278) is arrival-only; no portal leads back to 30000 in any version checked (v8, v22, v28-v39). returnMap 60000. Foothold extent x -309..2919 (3228 px), 23 tiers in 5 bands, 13 climbables (5 ladders, 8 ropes). v22 removes the Blue Snails and adds Sam (NPC 2005); v8 is canonical. From v37 (v34 is the last served version without them) the map has 16 climbables, and v49+ shortens it: both excluded. east00 is the v8 WZ value (2692,392); the brief and 40000.struct.json first carried (2812,397) from /api/GMS/39 and were corrected in the verification pass. Brief: docs/research/maps/40000_SnailHuntingGround1_40000.md.

maps.name: Snail Hunting Ground III

exits.note: East end of the summit ridge at y=-1164; the player must climb out.

maps.terrain_style: grassySoil tiles with embedded rocks (60 px step module); midForest backdrop; birch grove on the summit ridge.
maps.recognizable: The tallest of the three snail grounds and the first map with Red Snails. Its west half echoes Snail Hunting Ground I, then breaks off in a cliff; the way on is a long climb up stacked tiers to a summit ridge that spans the whole map, ending at a signposted exit in the top-right corner.
maps.notes: returnMap 60000. Foothold extent x -309..2919, y -1285..600; 25 tiers in 6 bands; 15 climbables (6 ladders, 9 ropes). v22-v55 move east00 to (2753,-685); v8 (2822,-1164) is canonical. From v37 it has 18 climbables (excluded). The brief and 40002.struct.json first carried inferred positions (west00 (-200,275), east00 (2800,-1165)) and a ground-tier fallback exit; they were corrected to the v8 WZ values (-19,274) and (2822,-1164) in the verification pass, and there is no exit at the east end of ground tier T24. Brief: docs/research/maps/40002_SnailHuntingGround3_40002.md.

A long, low map whose east end splits into two roads stacked one above the other, each with a wooden arrow sign: up to Amherst, down to Southperry and the ship. Near the start Maria waits by a red mailbox with a letter she needs delivered to Amherst, and the first Shrooms appear among the snails.

Foothold extent x -624..3234 (3858 px), y -175..570; 14 tiers in 4 bands; 8 climbables (2 ladders, 6 ropes). v22 adds Mai (12100) on a central platform (not in the v8 baseline). east00 is the v8 WZ value (3041,7); the brief and 50000.struct.json first carried (3033,2) from /api/GMS/37-39 and were corrected in the verification pass. landmarks: Whitewashed buildings with blue domes (housePT/house0 with arched wall and starfish, house2 square tower)
Armor Store exterior: white walls, wavy blue-tiled roof, barrel-topped chimney, arched door, hanging sign with a green shield-and-cross icon (door = in00)
Sunken market street below a 240 px cliff, with rolled carpets, bales and an iron-bound chest
Upper terrace with a canvas market gazebo, blue ceramic pots and Biggs

maps.recognizable: The sunny harbour town at the end of Maple Road and the island's exit: Mediterranean whitewashed houses with blue domes on white flagstones, a lighthouse, a grand staircase up to the quay, and the big three-masted ship Victoria with Shanks at the gangway. Clouds drift past instead of sea, fitting the official description of Maple Island as 'an island floating somewhere in the sky'. The short, cheerful 'Go Picnic' loop plays.
maps.notes: Only walkable exits: west00 (to A Split Road east01) and the Armor Store door in00. There is NO east portal: travel off the island is NPC-scripted through Shanks (22000) at (3223,-13), one way to Lith Harbor, 150 mesos (Hidden Street 2005; StrategyWiki 2006; MapleWiki 2007). Non-exit portal points: h001 (pt 1, no target) at (-1,43) next to Paul, renamed gm00 in v22 (probably a GM/hidden landing spot, not a player exit); 6 'tp' points (pt 6) at x 870..1327, y~524 ([memory] Mystic Door landing spots). Foothold extent x -662..4082, y -1145..720; 36 tiers; 7 climbables. Hidden Street 2006: 'Only the armour store is available here.' v22 replaces Tia with Ria. From v56 west00 leads to 50001 (excluded). Brief: docs/research/maps/60000_Southperry_60000.md.

maps.recognizable: The busy hub of Rainbow Street and the widest field on the island: a 3948 px road west to east with a sky archipelago of floating ledges about 25 steps high, and six little wooden doors with danger signs leading off to the forest and garden pockets. Players came back here again and again to pick a pocket. Islanders remembered the hard-to-reach 'pillar' ledge above the Mushroom Garden door (Basilmarket 2007).
maps.notes: Hub: 8 exits (west, east, 6 side doors). mobRate 1.3, returnMap 1010000 (Amherst). Foothold extent x -489..3459, walkable y -1045..455 (1500 px, ~25 steps of 60 px); 10 ground levels + 39 platform levels; 13 climbables (3 ladders, 10 ropes). Danger-sign variants by door: in00 "!" triangle, in01 and in02 wooden notice board, in03 none, in04 skull-and-DANGER triangle, in05 tilted skull (whether they encode difficulty is unconfirmed). v8 geometry (493 footholds) is canonical; v22 has 396. Exclude the 18 climbables of v37-v48, the v49+ rework (Stump, Slime and Pig spawns; west00 moves to x=830) and the v56+ Yoona. The raised block above the in05 platform has no v8 footholds: decoration. Brief: docs/research/maps/1000000_FieldWestOfAmherst_1000000.md.

branches.description: Sen's house through the orange mushroom house door (in01). Optional dead-end interior used by Nina's dinner errand; return to 20000 by the same door. The only side branch before the one-way funnel ends.

Rainbow Street. A Split Road's UPPER east exit (east00, signboard 'Amherst ->') leads east through The Field West of Amherst to Amherst and on to The Field East of Amherst, where the street ends (no further exit). Not needed to reach Southperry, but Maria's letter errand at 50000 sends players to Lucas in Amherst. The only way back to the main route is through 50000.

Six dead-end training pockets off The Field West of Amherst, each entered and left by one portal: in00 In a Small Forest, in01 Dangerous Forest (doorless, DANGER board), in02 Mushroom Garden and in03 Snail Garden (twin doors in the hollow mound), in04 and in05 the two Hunting Grounds Middle of the Forest (high doors).
Amherst shop interiors: Weapon Store (door in00 on the upper plateau, Sid) and Department Store (door in02 on the middle terrace, Lucy).
Amherst Townstreet (door in01 in the orange-spotted house) is a through-route: its west garden path (west00) is the ONLY way to the Snail Field of Flowers.
Tomato Field: dead-end pocket behind portal in00 (pt 1; [memory] an invisible portal type) on a high ledge of The Field East of Amherst, marked by a DANGER sign and tomato plants.
Southperry Armor Store (door in00 in the sunken market street, Pan).

Off-island exit: Shanks (NPC 22000) at the ship on the east quay sails one way to Lith Harbor, Victoria Island, for 150 mesos (Hidden Street 2005, StrategyWiki 2006, MapleWiki 2007). NPC-scripted, not a portal, outside the 25-map set. Maple Island is 'a mysterious island of no-return' (official GMS site 2005).

discrepancies.topic: Which data version is the baseline (v8 vs v22)
discrepancies.sources_disagree: Both are inside the target era. v22 adds Todd (NPC 2004) and 3 Tutorial Jr. Sentinels at 30000, Sam (NPC 2005) at 40000, moves Mai from Amherst to A Split Road, removes Blue Snails from 40000 and thins 40001/40002, replaces Tia with Ria, re-lays out map 0, extends 20000 east, reshuffles 30000 climbing aids, changes 40002 east00 and 1000000 geometry, and adds Up-key hint signs (wiki_maple_road.md section 5; entities.json v22_deltas).
discrepancies.decision: GMS v8 is the canonical baseline for topology, portal positions, geometry, NPC placement and spawns. v22 content is recorded as an optional "late 2005/2006 variant" only.
discrepancies.rationale: v8 is the only version for which the team holds the complete raw WZ portal set (25/25 maps pass the completeness check) and full foothold/object data for every map. Links are identical in v8 and v22, so the choice only affects placement and NPC content.

discrepancies.topic: When map 0 became the Training Camp
discrepancies.sources_disagree: Task brief: v40+. topology_sources.md: v37 is still "West Entrance to Mushroom Town", v38 is "Entrance - Mushroom Town Training Camp" (String/Map.img name + portal list). analyze:group1: v37 original, v39 already Training Camp (consistent with v38).
discrepancies.decision: Classic map 0 exists in GMS v8-v37 only; v38+ data for ID 0 is excluded.
discrepancies.rationale: Raw WZ map-name strings and portal lists at v37 and v38 (https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/37/String/Map.img/maple/0/mapName vs /GMS/38/...) are direct evidence; v39/v40 agree.

discrepancies.topic: When and how Maple Island was restructured (50001)
discrepancies.sources_disagree: Task brief: v62 added 50001 and only 50000 changed. topology_sources.md: the change is at v56 (v55 unchanged) and also rewires 60000 west00, 1000001/1000002 (to 50001), 1000005/1000006 (to 1020000), and cuts 1000000 to 4 portals; corroborated by TitanMS v62 XML.
discrepancies.decision: No v56+ link data is used anywhere. All 24 connections are v8 links (identical through v55 except map 0).
discrepancies.rationale: Version bisection over every GMS version the WZ endpoint serves (v8, v22, v28, v32, v34, v37-v62).

discrepancies.topic: Portal positions for 40000 east00, 40002 west00/east00 and 50000 east00
discrepancies.sources_disagree: analyze:group2 struct.json files and briefs used out-of-era parsed-API or inferred positions because the v8 API JSON had nulls: 40000 east00 (2812,397) from v39; 40002 west00 (-200,275) inferred; 40002 east00 (2800,-1165) inferred; 50000 east00 (3033,2) from v37-v39. The raw v8 WZ nodes give (2692,392), (-19,274), (2822,-1164) and (3041,7).
discrepancies.decision: Use the raw v8 WZ values (portals_xml.json) in topology.json. In the verification pass the four entries in 40000/40002/50000.struct.json and the matching brief rows were patched to the WZ values (old values kept in their notes), the 40002 brief lost its ground-tier fallback exit, and the struct.json source_version fields now say where earlier values came from.
discrepancies.rationale: The WZ node tree is the v8 client data itself and covers every portal; the other values are from later builds or estimates.

discrepancies.topic: A Split Road <-> The Field West of Amherst link, and which end of Southperry links to A Split Road
discrepancies.sources_disagree: worldmap.md marked 50000 <-> 1000000 as inferred only (all portals null in the API) and said Southperry's connecting end was undeterminable. Raw v8 WZ: 50000 east00 (3041,7) -> 1000000:west00 and back; 50000 east01 (3046,361) -> 60000:west00 (-547,286, the far west end) and back.
discrepancies.decision: Both links are recorded as source xml, confidence high. Southperry connects at its west end; its east end is the ship dock.
discrepancies.rationale: Direct portal data supersedes inference from the world-map drawing; the two agree in direction (Amherst branch east/upper, Southperry south/lower).

discrepancies.topic: Where the Tomato Field entrance is
discrepancies.sources_disagree: wiki_rainbow_street.md inferred the orange mushroom-cap house at the far east ground of 1020000; worldmap.md proposed that Tomato Field joins Field East at its left end. Raw v8 WZ: 1020000 in00 is a pt 1 portal ([memory] an invisible type) at (1792,-384) on a high ledge, beside a DANGER sign and 3 tomato plants; the far-east orange mushrooms are decorative (house13). Tomato Field's own exit is at its west end.
discrepancies.decision: Use the WZ position: inner portal (pt 1) on the high east-side ledge of 1020000.
discrepancies.rationale: Portal and object positions are data; the other two placements were inferences made while the portal was unparsed.

discrepancies.topic: Six Rainbow Street portals reported as unparsed
discrepancies.sources_disagree: wiki_rainbow_street.md: positions unknown for 1010000 in02, 1010001 out00, 1010002 out00/west00, 1020000 in00 and 1000003 out00 (destinations confirmed by the Hidden Street Dec 2005 diagram and MapleTip 2007). Raw v8 WZ gives all of them.
discrepancies.decision: Use the WZ positions. 1010000 in02 = (1516,156), which matches the wiki's diagram-based estimate of x 1500-1600 on the middle terrace.
discrepancies.rationale: WZ data is complete; the archived diagram independently corroborates the destinations and the Department Store door position.

discrepancies.topic: One-way Mushroom Town chain (0 -> 10000 -> 20000 -> 30000 -> 40000)
discrepancies.sources_disagree: Every team flagged it for confirmation. Data: the in00 arrival points in 10000/20000/30000/40000 are pt 1 with no target, and no portal leads back west in v8, v22 or v28-v39. A 2005 Hidden Street beginner guide says Heena 'will take you to the next screen/map', and Peter's v8 dialogue says 'If you want to move on to the next stage, talk to me': NPC-scripted warps may exist, and portal data cannot show them.
discrepancies.decision: Recorded as four one-way connections (bidirectional false), source xml, confidence high. Whether MisoStory adds return paths is a design decision for the project owner, not a data question. NPC warps are not modelled.
discrepancies.rationale: Consistent across every version checked; it matches the remembered and documented feel of a tutorial funnel.

discrepancies.topic: Mai's position
discrepancies.sources_disagree: v8 data puts Mai (12100) at (628,-176) on the Amherst upper plateau; the Hidden Street Dec 2005 diagram independently labels her on the plateau next to the weapon store (text labels only, so no coordinates). v22 places her at A Split Road (1891,-175) with new training lines.
discrepancies.decision: Mai stands in Amherst (v8 baseline). The A Split Road position is the v22 variant.
discrepancies.rationale: Follows the baseline decision. The position comes from v8 data alone; the Dec 2005 diagram independently agrees on the plateau.

discrepancies.topic: Field West of Amherst geometry (v8 vs v22)
discrepancies.sources_disagree: v8 has 493 footholds, v22 has 396; ladders, ropes, mobs and portals are identical (wiki_rainbow_street.md).
discrepancies.decision: Use v8 geometry, as in docs/research/maps/1000000.struct.json.
discrepancies.rationale: Baseline decision. The portal positions in topology.json are v8, and the 1000000 brief assigns each of them to a v8 tier (G1, G6, G10, P20, P26c, P29, P30).

discrepancies.topic: 20001 'Mushroom Town Townstreet' is Sen's house
discrepancies.sources_disagree: WZ name says Townstreet; the v8 content is a two-storey house interior (Hidden Street 2006 'head into the house', StrategyWiki 2007). The same template is reused for 1010002 Amherst Townstreet.
discrepancies.decision: Keep the canonical name and slug exactly. Classify 20001 as kind interior (dead end behind a door) and 1010002 as townstreet (through-route). [proposal] An in-game display alias such as "Sen's House" is a project decision.
discrepancies.rationale: Slugs are fixed by the canonical list; kind follows function, and matches how src/misostory/layout.py already treats the two maps.

discrepancies.topic: Street name of the Mushroom Town and Snail Hunting Ground maps
discrepancies.sources_disagree: Hidden Street's 2005 map list prefixes Mushroom Town, Snail Hunting Ground and Split Road maps with 'Rainbow Street'; the WZ streetName is 'Maple Road' for every map 0-60001 and 'Rainbow Street' for every 10xxxxx map.
discrepancies.decision: Use the WZ streetName.
discrepancies.rationale: Data over wiki. [memory] The Hidden Street label is probably a translation of the Korean street name.

discrepancies.topic: Order and identity of the two "Mushroom Town" maps
discrepancies.sources_disagree: The world map groups 10000, 20000 and 20001 under one spot, so it cannot order them.
discrepancies.decision: 10000 is west of 20000: 0 -> 10000 -> 20000 -> 30000. 10000 = Roger and the yellow house (Hidden Street "Mushroom Town I"); 20000 = Nina and the enterable orange house (Hidden Street "Mushroom Town II").
discrepancies.rationale: Portal data (10000 out00 -> 20000 in00 at 20000's far west); Hidden Street 2005 thumbnails match the v8 minimap sizes to within 1 px.

discrepancies.topic: Climbable art: which maps use green vines
discrepancies.sources_disagree: wiki_rainbow_street.md (from renders) says Dangerous Forest is the only map with vine ropes. The WZ object data shows vines (connect/rope/3) in 1000002, all 11 climbables of 1010004, and the 5 ropes of 1020001.
discrepancies.decision: Use the WZ object data.
discrepancies.rationale: Object data over a reading of partial renders.

discrepancies.topic: Field backgrounds: dark/cloudy vs blue sky
discrepancies.sources_disagree: Hidden Street 2005 thumbnails of the Rainbow Street pockets show a dark grey, cloudy backdrop; the v8 and v22 WZ background nodes say blue sky with white clouds (grassySoil set).
discrepancies.decision: Blue sky with white clouds (WZ).
discrepancies.rationale: WZ data over small, probably darkened thumbnails; the 2006 Field East screenshot also shows a bright blue sky.

discrepancies.topic: Shanks' ship: destination and fare
discrepancies.sources_disagree: entities.json marks the destination and fare as [memory]; wiki_maple_road.md cites four era sources: Hidden Street Nov 2005 "Lith Harbor (pay 150 mesos)", a Hidden Street Aug 2005 guide, StrategyWiki 2006 and MapleWiki 2007. A later web summary says 500 mesos (unverified, later era).
discrepancies.decision: One-way voyage to Lith Harbor, Victoria Island, 150 mesos (wiki-sourced). Recorded as NPC travel in notes/branches, not as a portal connection.
discrepancies.rationale: Wiki over memory; the portal data has no east exit in 60000.

discrepancies.topic: Who gives and who completes 'Todd's How-To Hunt'
discrepancies.sources_disagree: Hidden Street 2006: Peter gives, Todd completes. StrategyWiki 2007: Todd gives, Peter completes.
discrepancies.decision: Not part of the v8 baseline (Todd is v22-only). If the v22 variant is ever built, follow StrategyWiki.
discrepancies.rationale: v22 NPC placement (Todd at the entrance, Peter at the exit) favours StrategyWiki.

discrepancies.topic: Name of mob 120100: 'Shroom' vs 'Spore'
discrepancies.sources_disagree: v22 quest text calls it 'Spore'; the mob name data says 'Shroom' in every version checked (v8-v95).
discrepancies.decision: Shroom.
discrepancies.rationale: Mob data over quest text.

discrepancies.topic: Exit kinds: when is a portal an edge exit?
discrepancies.sources_disagree: Verification found the edge/inner split inconsistent: 1000002 out01 (89 px from the west limit, on the top-left row that starts at that limit) was inner while 30000 out00 (136 px from the east limit, on the summit) was edge_east; 1010004 east00 (290 px from the east limit, on a full-width rim) was inner while 40002 west00 (290 px from the west limit) was edge_west. A pure distance threshold such as 160 px does not work either: it would turn 40000 east00 (227 px), 40002 west00 (290), 50000 east00/east01 (193/188), 0 out00 (202) and 1010000 east00 (223) into inner.
discrepancies.decision: edge_*/inner are positional: a non-door exit is edge_<side> when the v8 foothold chain under it reaches that side's foothold limit (0 px tolerance; the nearer limit wins if both), otherwise inner. The rule reproduces 42 of the 44 previous kinds; 1000002 out01 becomes edge_west and 1010004 east00 becomes edge_east. The build script checks the rule on every run.
discrepancies.rationale: One computable meaning for kind. Every inner exit stands on a ledge that stops well short of the nearer limit (1000001 out00 90 px, 1020000 in00 180 px, 1000000 in01 270 px), so the rule has a clear margin. No code in src/ reads kind from topology.json today (layout.py keeps its own portal table).

discrepancies.topic: Quest data in v8, and which quests belong to the baseline era
discrepancies.sources_disagree: entities.md and MAP_INVENTORY section 9 said v8 has no quest data (the parsed /api/GMS/8/quest/1000 returns 404), so every quest role was tagged [v22 data]. The raw v8 WZ has Etc/QuestInfo.img (https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Data/Etc/QuestInfo.img) with 43 entries; its only Maple Island entry (island=0) is 0000100, titled Bigg's Collection of Items. The Hidden Street beginner guide (v1.20, dated August 2005, archived 2005-10-13) describes Heena's quest and Sera's mirror, Roger's apple-and-potion lesson, an unnamed 'simple quest' on the 3rd screen, Maria's hat quest and Biggs' collection. Todd, Sam, Pio, Rain's quiz and Mai's training first appear in Hidden Street's quest list of Feb 2006.
discrepancies.decision: Quests are split by attestation in section 9: the 2005-attested ones belong to the baseline era, the Feb 2006 ones to the late-2005/2006 variant. Quest IDs, item names and step text still come from v22 and stay tagged [v22 data]; Biggs' quest is tagged [v8 data: Etc/QuestInfo.img/0000100].
discrepancies.rationale: Raw WZ over the parsed endpoint, and a dated era guide over an inference from a 404. A missing QuestInfo entry is not evidence that a quest did not exist: the 2005 guide shows the tutorial quests did.

discrepancies.topic: First post-classic rework: v49, not v55
discrepancies.sources_disagree: Section 9 and topology_sources.md said v55 reworks the geometry, 1020000 is redesigned once 'about v57', Stump/Slime/Pig arrive in v55+ and Yoona in v62+, and v40 adds easing climbables to four maps. Verification (parsed /api/GMS/<v>/map and raw WZ portal nodes): v48 equals v40 for every map checked; v49 is the first version with reworked geometry (40000, 40001, 50000, 60000, 1000000-1000006, 1010000, 1020000, 1020001), with Stump (130100), Slime (210100) and Pig (1210100) in 1000000 and Slime and Pig in 1020000; 1020000 in00 changes from pt 1 at (1792,-384) to pt 2 at (1874,-266). 1020000 changes again at v56, when Yoona (20100) appears in 1000000. The extra climbables are first present at v37 (v34 is the last served version without them; v35-v36 are not served), in 11 maps.
discrepancies.decision: Exclusion boundaries: climbables first present at v37, geometry and spawns from v49, links from v56. Links stay identical through v55 except map 0 (D3 stands).
discrepancies.rationale: Version bisection over the served versions, done in the verification pass. The earlier v55/v57/v62 dates were the first versions the team happened to sample, not the first changed ones.
